title: Nationwide Gathering Against Tech
body: Thousands attend Asifas Hatzalah in Bnei Brak, led by Rav Tzvi Meir Zilberberg, who delivers a powerful address on resisting modern technology's dangers. Participants commit to limiting tech use until 4 A.M.

title: Orthodox Rabbi Confronted in Capitol
body: Rabbi Yaakov Menken, executive vice president of the Coalition for Jewish Values, was targeted in a Capitol hallway confrontation by a pro-Palestinian activist who shouted antisemitic accusations related to Israel's war against Hamas.
